neighbours.label: the token ' experience' as a qualification noun (years of / have / with / prior experience), not the event sense ('a wonderful experience', 'user experience') or the verb
fire: Candidates should have experience with large databases.

Some previous experience of teaching is preferred.
Our guides have many years of experience on the mountain.
Do you have experience working with children?
The role requires five years of experience in accounting.
Volunteers with experience in first aid are welcome.
quiet: Visiting the glacier was an unforgettable experience for us.

Most patients experience mild side effects at first.
The redesign improves the user experience on small screens.
